name: Facilitation of Large Size Godowns in APMC and Taluka-District Purchase Sale Union (General)
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** Provides crucial capital assistance for the construction of large-sized godowns.  - **Infrastructure Development:** Supports the development of essential infrastructure for agricultural activities like processing, grading, cleaning, washing, shortening, packaging, and branding.  - **Enhanced Marketing Capabilities:** Enables unions to strengthen their marketing and sell
_eligibility_text: - Cooperative institutions operating at the taluka or district level within the state of Gujarat are eligible under this scheme. - The institution should be registered under the appropriate cooperative society laws. - The institution should have plans for setting up or expanding facilities like storage godowns, processing units, grading and packaging infrastructure, or branding and marketing systems.
